content.title: CBS Executives Explain Why They Canceled 'NCIS: Hawaii,' 'So Help Me Todd,' & 'CSI: Vegas' (& If They Could Transfer to Paramount+) - IMDb
content.text: CBS Executives Explain Why They Canceled 'NCIS: Hawaii,' 'So Help Me Todd,' & 'CSI: Vegas' (& If They Could Transfer to Paramount+)CBS executives are revealing why they decided to cancel So Help Me Todd, CSI: Vegas and NCIS: Hawaii.If you don’t know, the network renewed 15 TV shows this year, but did cancel 3 and announced several are ending.Keep reading to find out more…When asked why those three shows were canceled, they responded, “It is incumbent on us to always keep the schedule fresh, keep momentum going. We had to make some really tough choices this year,” CBS Entertainment president Amy Reisenbach shared. “Everything came back [from the Hollywood strikes] really strong, but ultimately we have to look at the cohesiveness of the schedule flow. We have to evaluate the financials and the performance overall, and we make tough decisions.”“Every show is different,” CBS CEO George Cheeks added. “We certainly had a wonderful experience with So Help Me Todd.
